bio: Luxare has been fascinated by gems for as long as she can remember. She was entranced at how these mere rocks could hold within them, universes of power. Luxare has dedicated everything to unraveling the mystery of the gems – housing her vast collection in a giant bejeweled dome, high in the mountains. She's even managed to tempt some Stonehearts to help in her quest. Now that's a true achievement.
